components.css: .ds-filter-track{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e7ece8);width:240px}.ds-filter{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:650 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;padding:0 1px 14px;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--accent,#13765b);color:var(--accent,#13765b);min-height:42px;background:none;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0}.ds-filter span{font-size:11px;min-width:12px}.ds-filter:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#13765b);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Task Row
components.description: Unframed pending-task row with circular completion and group metadata.
components.html:
整理今天的拍摄素材
工作
components.css: .ds-task{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:77px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#e7ece8);max-width:390px;color:var(--ink,#222c28);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}.ds-check{align-self:stretch;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:32px;flex:none;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}.ds-check span{display:block;width:21px;height:21px;border:1.5px solid #93a69a;border-radius:50%;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s}.ds-check:hover span{background:var(--accent-soft,#e9f3ee);border-color:var(--accent,#13765b)}.ds-task-body{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:16px 0}.ds-task-title{font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-task-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted,#626f68);margin-top:5px}.ds-task-meta span{width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent,#13765b)}.ds-task-edit{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:30px;height:40px;background:none;border:0;border-radius:6px;color:var(--muted,#626f68);cursor:pointer}.ds-task-edit svg{width:15px;height:15px}.ds-task-edit:hover{background:var(--surface,#f5f7f5);filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-check:focus-visible,.ds-task-edit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#13765b);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-check span{transition:none}}

components.name: Lock-Screen Activity
components.description: Fixed-height translucent card with an internally scrolling task list; completed rows remain crossed out and half opaque.
components.html: 今天的待办0/6
components.css: .ds-activity{height:160px;max-width:338px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--card-bg,rgba(17,43,36,.85));backdrop-filter:blur(var(--card-blur,24px)) saturate(var(--card-saturate,.85));-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(var(--card-blur,24px)) saturate(var(--card-saturate,.85));padding:10px 12px 0;overflow:hidden;color:var(--card-ink,#f4fbf7);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}.ds-activity-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;height:22px;margin-bottom:2px}.ds-activity-heading>span:first-child{font-weight:550}.ds-activity-count{font-size:10px;color:var(--card-muted,#e0eae4)}.ds-activity-list{height:90px;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;overscroll-behavior-y:contain;touch-action:pan-y;scrollbar-width:thin}.ds-lock-task{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;height:30px;width:100%;text-align:left;font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:400;padding:0;border:0;background:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-lock-check{width:15px;height:15px;border:1.5px solid var(--card-check,#c6eed2);border-radius:50%;flex:none}.ds-lock-task>span:last-child{white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.6;flex:1;min-width:0}.ds-lock-task:hover .ds-lock-check{background:#b9ebcb38}.ds-activity-footer{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--card-rule,#d4eddf40);height:33px;width:100%;padding:0;font:400 9px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;background:none;color:var(--card-muted,#e0eae4);cursor:pointer}.ds-activity-footer:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-lock-task:focus-visible,.ds-activity-footer:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#13765b);outline-offset:4px}

components.description: Temporary status with undo after completing or deleting a task.

components.css: .ds-toast{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;background:#233b30;color:#fff;padding:9px 10px 9px 18px;border-radius:8px;max-width:390px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px #152e2730;font:400 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;letter-spacing:0}.ds-toast>span{min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-undo{color:#b9f3cd;font:400 13px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;min-height:36px;flex:none;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-close{color:#def1e3;width:30px;height:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:none;cursor:pointer}.ds-close svg{width:20px;height:20px}.ds-close:hover{background:var(--surface,#f5f7f5)}.ds-undo:hover,.ds-close:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}.ds-undo:focus-visible,.ds-close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#13765b);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
The implemented prototype follows the user's lock-screen reference: a real photograph, a prominent clock, and a translucent checklist. A quiet white task workspace makes the full list editable beside that preview on larger screens. The name remains provisional.

The interface is compact and practical. System Chinese typography, restrained green actions, rose life labels, fine dividers, and small icon controls support repeated task work. Completing an item breaks the task into fragments, then moves its crossed-out, half-opacity record to the end of the card list. This document records the web prototype in `outputs/locktodo`; it does not specify a built native iOS interface.
keyCharacteristics: Photographic wallpaper with a large white clock.
Translucent task box with independently adjustable material, color, transparency, and text tone.
Light workspace with restrained color and fine dividers.
Compact task rows with visible completion, edit, and pin controls.
Reversible completion with optional shattering feedback.

rules.name: The Independent Appearance Rule
rules.body: Changing the application accent must not change the checklist material, base color, transparency, or text mode. These are separate settings in the implementation.

dos: **Do** preserve the photographic wallpaper, prominent clock, and translucent checklist reference.
**Do** keep the complete editable task list accessible from the bounded preview.
**Do** keep material, color, transparency, and text mode independent.
**Do** retain visible focus treatments and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** keep completed tasks reversible through undo or restore.
donts: **Don't** replace the photograph with an abstract decorative background.
**Don't** turn the task workspace into a marketing hero or a stack of decorative cards.
**Don't** imply that the browser preview installs or modifies a native iPhone lock screen.
**Don't** truncate the full editable task title just because preview rows truncate.
**Don't** infer wallpaper-aware text contrast from the automatic base-color calculation.
